title: Fake multisig keys
note: Plumb counts a key as signed only when a signature in the spend verifies against it. This row marks a CHECKMULTISIG with more than ten 33-byte keys. A 2-of-3 stays out. It does not see a key that is not in that multisig, or a 32-byte tapscript key. Those are SFS-32, which is off.
